assets.name: warrior-sd
assets.detail: Class Warrior: simple brown leather and steel shoulder armor, muted red tunic, brown short boots, plain broad silver two-handed greatsword with a dark grip. Simple gear, not ornate. Same head size and body length as the reference first swordsman.
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel-art RPG player avatar, one character only. Input image is the authoritative existing Jongchan character sheet, used as identity and strict art-style reference. Recreate the SAME black short-haired male face, thick brows, tiny dark eyes, skin palette, huge round-square head, short stocky SD body, tiny boots, dark chunky outline and simple flat pixel clusters of the reference first-row swordsman. The head must be approximately 45% of the human body height, the whole human body about 2.2 heads tall. This is NOT a realistic knight and NOT a detailed miniature. Draw as if at logical 48x56 resolution, enlarged with crisp nearest-neighbor blocks. Limited flat palette, two shades per material, no fine texture, no soft shading or lighting. Front-facing slightly three-quarter neutral standing pose. Full body and full weapon fit with generous transparent padding. No backdrop, no glow, no text, no ground, no shadow, no labels, no extra character. Hold a visibly large TWO-HANDED GREAT SWORD with both hands, but keep face completely clear, sword never crossing face. The blade can rise beside the head but must not dominate the scale. Keep the identical cute face and compact proportions from the reference. Class Warrior: simple brown leather and steel shoulder armor, muted red tunic, brown short boots, plain broad silver two-handed greatsword with a dark grip. Simple gear, not ornate. Same head size and body length as the reference first swordsman.
